author: u. m. simon
title: Hawai'i men's tennis to finish regular season with road matches against UC Irvine and UC San Diego - Maui Reporter
text:
The University of Hawai’i men’s tennis team is set to conclude its regular season on the road, according to an April 13 announcement. The Rainbow Warriors will face UC Irvine on Friday, April 17 at Arnhold Tennis Stadium and then travel to play UC San Diego on Sunday, April 19 at Northview Courts in La Jolla.
These final matches are important as they mark the end of the Big West Conference regular season for Hawai’i, which currently holds a record of 9-8 overall and 2-2 in conference play. The outcomes could influence postseason positioning.
In their upcoming matchups, Hawai’i faces a challenging history against both opponents. Against UC Irvine, the Rainbow Warriors have a record of four wins and twenty-one losses. Their last meeting ended in a 4-1 loss for Hawai’i on March 28, 2025; UC Irvine has won the last thirteen meetings between the teams. In contrast, Hawai’i has fared better historically against UC San Diego with six wins and three losses but dropped their most recent encounter by a score of 4-2 on April 5, 2025. UC San Diego has won the last two contests between these programs.
Last week, Hawai’i ended its home schedule with a victory over UC Davis by a score of 4-1. Seniors Timothy Li and Azuma Visaya secured singles victories that clinched the win after Toa Maeda and Kent Mueller put UH ahead early. The result snapped a four-match losing streak for the Rainbow Warriors.
Individually this season, Visaya leads in singles with an overall record of eight wins and six losses while playing exclusively at No.1 singles court; he is undefeated (2-0) in conference play. Freshman Kent Mueller enters this final week holding seven wins from eleven matches across No.4 and No.5 positions.
In doubles competition, Dzhenev and Mueller have been particularly successful as partners at No.3 doubles court with an eight-win two-loss record this year including four consecutive victories.
